newsitem.title: CHINA: China Supreme Court rejects princeling's appeal.
newsitem.headline: China Supreme Court rejects princeling's appeal.

text.p: China's Supreme Court on Thursday rejected an appeal by a son of a member of the political elite who was recently given a suspended death sentence for corruption, the Xinhua news agency said.

Zhou Beifang, former chairman of Hong Kong-listed affiliates of the giant state-owned Capital Iron and Steel Corp, had appealed after he was convicted by the Beijing Intermediate People's Court recently, Xinhua said.
The Supreme Court also rejected the appeals of two co-defendants and upheld their sentences of 15 and 16 years in prison, the agency said.
A fourth defendant, Li Min, who was sentenced to life imprisonment, and a fifth defendant who was sentenced to five years in prison, did not appeal.
Yet another defendant, Qu Aiqun, was exempted from criminal punishment, the agency said. It gave no further details.
Zhou was detained in February, 1995, forcing his father, Zhou Guanwu, to resign as chairman and Communist Party secretary of state-owned Capital Iron and Steel Corp.
